summary: The registered analysis agrees with the authors’ reported decreases in Avp and Oxt. Neither reaches registered FDR < 0.05. Across all 13 Figure 2A markers with a registered result, seven expression directions agree and six differ. The review closes for these selected markers. [Published Figure 2](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC11127955/#Fig2)
openIssues: Figure 2 plots deposited SHAM-2 and SHAM-3. The registered analysis also includes SHAM-1 (GSM7178967). The authors’ fitted sample manifest is needed to determine whether their DESeq2 analysis also omitted SHAM-1.
The complete author DESeq2 table was not located. Genome-wide effect agreement, exact author P values and FDRs, and discovery overlap remain unassessed.
